A few things you might be wondering.

Can you build a mobile app or AI tool?

Yes. Mobile apps, document assistants, and custom AI integrations are scoped individually. Tell me the main task your users need to complete, and we can define a practical first version.

What if I already have a website?

I can help with a redesign, speed improvements, backend work, or integrations. We’ll review what is worth keeping before pricing the changes.

Will I own the website?

Your custom project code and content are handed over after final payment. Third-party software, assets, and services remain subject to their own licences.

Do I need to know which package fits?

No. A short description of your business and what the website should do is enough to start the conversation.
